Cc: support@whistic.com
Date: Tue, 04 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Portal profile lifecycle takeover request — CAIQ claim normalization

Hi RoHan,

Thanks again for the SOC 2 snapshot you sent last month. We're in the middle of consolidating vendor evidence in Whistic and found a few CAIQ claims on Redwood's profile that are out-of-sync with the latest artifacts (some controls still point to older S3 paths and an archived KMS key). Before our procurement team signs off, we need a short ownership transfer and evidence-retention sync so the profile reflects the current state.

Can Redwood do the following next week?
- Confirm portal ownership transfer (or delegate) for Whistic/Vendr profiles
- Attach updated SOC 2 summary and map CAIQ claim IDs to current evidence
- Confirm data retention and S3 bucket TTL (we need 18 months minimum for our contractual window)

I've attached a small CAIQ claim matrix we started — it highlights 7 claims that look stale. Also attaching the SOC 2 summary for reference. If you can appoint an internal owner for the portal handoff and share a quick mutual action plan, we can move the approval forward.

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (PDF), caiq-claim-matrix.csv (CSV)

Best,
Sarah Locke
Senior Security Program Manager
Cloudwave Analytics

Monica, confirm the retention windows and provide the S3 lifecycle policy excerpt we can attach.

Checklist for the pass:
- For each CAIQ claim: status (current / replaced / not-applicable), artifact link, short note on why it changed
- If an artifact is archived, indicate TTL and whether we can re-host a retained copy for 18 months
- Confirm encryption KMS key id and whether the key is customer-managed or Redwood-managed
- Capture a single-line acceptance statement for Whistic: "Redwood confirms artifact X covers CAIQ claim Y as of 2026-08-05"

Keep the comments as short bullet rows in the CSV. Sarah needs a mutual action plan by EOD Thu; aim for Wed morning delivery so I can review.
